IPv4 header constants, fields, address helpers, checksum, and parsing functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines IPv4 packet constants, field masks, and helper macros for working with IPv4 headers in C. It declares the `fd_ip4_hdr_t` union, which maps the IPv4 header layout and gives access to fields such as version, header length, addresses, checksum, and fragment data. The file also provides inline functions to test address classes, compute and validate the IPv4 header checksum, parse an IPv4 address from a string, check whether an address is public, and swap header fields between host and network byte order. It is a utility interface for low-level IPv4 packet handling and header manipulation.
